deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027 (fall entry only); same deadline for international applicants.
deadline.quote: PhD Fall Admission - Dec 15 (Fall admit only) | *Application deadlines are the same for both domestic and international applicants

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is mentioned; the GRE in general is optional.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for all Statistics graduate programs.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional for admission to all graduate programs in Statistics.

supervisor.value: The Statistics pages checked do not say whether you need an advisor before applying.

funding.value: PhD applicants are automatically considered for a tuition-waiving TA or RA, but support is awarded competitively.
funding.quote: PhD applicants in Statistics are automatically considered for a tuition-waiver-generating assistantship. Departmental teaching and research assistantship support is available on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: A four-year degree with a solid maths background (advanced calculus or real analysis, probability) is enough; minor gaps can be fixed in year one.
entry_route.quote: All graduate programs in Statistics require an applicant to have obtained, or will have obtained by date of enrollment, a minimum of a 4 year post-secondary degree from an accredited institute as recognized by the Graduate College.

notes: English minimums follow the Graduate College (TOEFL 79 old scale, IELTS 6.5); TA roles need spoken-English proof.
